user.title: Set up your Tandem Source account
user.description: Enter your Tandem Diabetes Source credentials. This connects to source.tandemdiabetes.com (US) or source.eu.tandemdiabetes.com (EU) to fetch data from your Tandem t:slim X2 pump.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate
reauth_confirm.description: Your Tandem Source credentials have expired or are invalid. Please re-enter them to continue.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure integration
reconfigure.description: Update your integration settings. Authentication credentials are preserved from the original setup.
